Written Test for Staff Nurse Posts
Thursday, 18 May 2023
5160 Hits
We are glad to inform you that you are invited to appear for written examination. Reporting time is 10.00 AM Dated 28/05/2023 at MS Office, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram. Please note that No TA & DA for attending the written test will be given.
Appearing for the written examination does not give you any claim for appointment.
Candidate list for Written Examination
Note: -
You are requested to bring one id proof
(Aadhar Card/Driving License/Election Card or any identity proof given by government)
at time of examination.
Please paste self-attested passport size latest photograph on the box given above.
Please bring your examination note pad for the written examination.
In case even if you didn’t get call letter for written examination all applicants who applied for last advertisement for the post of Staff Nurse will be eligible for written examination.
In case of any doubt, please contact MS Office (Personal Section) by 26
th
May, 3 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
